findings.title: [P1] Restore tenant isolation for document reads
findings.body: When `userTenant` differs from `documentTenant`, this function now still returns `true`. Any caller relying on this exported authorization predicate therefore permits cross-tenant document access. Preserve the previous equality check or use an equivalent tenant-aware policy.

findings.title: [P1] Restore the tenant equality check before permitting document reads
findings.body:
`canReadDocument` now returns `true` when `userTenant !== documentTenant`, allowing any caller to authorize cross-tenant document access and bypass tenant isolation.

_Recommend validating this comment independently._

findings.title: [P1] Restore tenant isolation when authorizing document reads
findings.body:
`canReadDocument` now authorizes every request. Any user whose `userTenant` differs from a document’s `documentTenant` will still receive `true`, enabling cross-tenant document access wherever this exported authorization function guards reads.

_Recommend validating this comment independently._
